questions.q: What is the headquarters of South West Khasi Hills district?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Mawkyrwat. It is the district headquarters of South West Khasi Hills. Nongpoh is associated with Ri-Bhoi, Khliehriat with East Jaintia Hills and Williamnagar with East Garo Hills. Exam takeaway: Learn district–headquarters pairs separately from major towns.
Source: https://southwestkhasihills.gov.in/
questions.source: Official district administration site; original practice

questions.q: Khliehriat is the headquarters of which Meghalaya district?
questions.e:
Correct answer: East Jaintia Hills. Khliehriat is the district headquarters; West Jaintia Hills is headquartered at Jowai, East Khasi Hills at Shillong and South West Khasi Hills at Mawkyrwat. Exam takeaway: Do not confuse East and West Jaintia Hills.
Source: https://eastjaintiahills.gov.in/
questions.source: Official district administration site; original practice

questions.q: Under which Article may the President promulgate an ordinance when Parliament is not in session, subject to constitutional conditions?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Article 123. It allows an ordinance when both Houses are not simultaneously in session and immediate action is considered necessary; the ordinance is temporary and subject to constitutional limits. Article 72 concerns pardons, 143 advisory opinions and 356 President's Rule. Exam takeaway: President—123; Governor—213.
Source: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/

questions.q: In which House of Parliament can a Money Bill be introduced?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Lok Sabha only. Articles 109–110 provide the special procedure: the Speaker certifies a Money Bill and the Rajya Sabha may make recommendations within 14 days. The Rajya Sabha cannot introduce it; ordinary Bills may be introduced in either House, and a joint sitting is not the Money Bill procedure. Exam takeaway: Money Bill—Lok Sabha introduction.
Source: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/

questions.q: Who introduced the Permanent Settlement in Bengal in 1793?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Lord Cornwallis. The 1793 settlement fixed the land-revenue demand payable by zamindars to the East India Company in Bengal. Wellesley is associated with the Subsidiary Alliance; Dalhousie with annexation policies; Hastings was not the introducer of this settlement. Exam takeaway: Permanent Settlement—1793—Bengal—Cornwallis.
Source: https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.q: What is the name of the Brahmaputra before it enters India from Tibet?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Yarlung Tsangpo. The river enters India in Arunachal Pradesh as the Siang or Dihang and later is known as the Brahmaputra in Assam. Irrawaddy, Salween and Mekong are separate Asian river systems. Exam takeaway: Transboundary rivers may have different names along their course.
Source: https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.q: Which office compiles India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI)?
o: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
questions.e:
Correct answer: Office of the Economic Adviser under DPIIT. It releases WPI data measuring wholesale price movements for a basket of goods. The Election Commission administers elections, NITI Aayog is a policy think tank and the CAG audits public accounts. Exam takeaway: WPI—Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT.
Source: https://eaindustry.nic.in/

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Each of the candidates ___ received an admit card.
questions.e:
Correct answer: has. 'Each' is singular here, so the sentence is 'Each of the candidates has received an admit card.' The plural noun 'candidates' is in a prepositional phrase and does not control the verb. 'Have' is plural; 'are' and 'were' do not fit the present-perfect construction. Exam takeaway: Identify the grammatical subject, not the nearest noun.
Source: https://www.mpsc.meghalaya.gov.in/

questions.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 4:7 and their sum is 99. What is the smaller number?
questions.e:
Correct answer: 36. Step-by-step: total parts = 4 + 7 = 11; one part = 99 ÷ 11 = 9; smaller number = 4 × 9 = 36; larger = 7 × 9 = 63. Check: 36 + 63 = 99 and 36:63 simplifies to 4:7. The other options fail the ratio-and-sum check. Quick method: divide the total by total parts, then multiply by the smaller part.
Source: https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.q: A net force of 1 N acts on a 1 kg mass. What acceleration results?
questions.e:
Correct answer: 1 m/s². Formula: F = m × a, so a = F ÷ m. Substitution: a = 1 N ÷ 1 kg = 1 kg·m/s² ÷ 1 kg = 1 m/s². The other values do not satisfy the stated force and mass. Exam takeaway: 1 newton = 1 kg·m/s²; keep units in mechanics calculations.
Source: https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the GST Council?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Article 279A. It provides for the GST Council, which recommends key GST policy matters. Article 246A concerns legislative power for GST; Article 269A concerns inter-State GST; Article 280 provides for the Finance Commission. Exam takeaway: GST Council—279A; GST legislative power—246A; inter-State GST—269A; Finance Commission—280.
Source: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/
